artifacts.summary: 5-phase Strategy B implementation plan: Reynolds k-equivalence bypass eliminating IsSuccArchimedean over-engineering

memory_candidates.content: Reynolds 1994 completeness for discrete linear temporal logic does NOT require proving the chronicle limit domain is Z-isomorphic (IsSuccArchimedean). The correct approach is k-equivalence: one_class (all points contemp_equiv) -> very_good -> good (Lemma 16, lexicographic sum) -> k-equiv to Z-interval -> truth transfer. The formalization's IsSuccArchimedean demand via succ_embed_surjective is an architectural over-engineering artifact of the BX pipeline. The sorry-free infrastructure (one_class in NoGapsDiscreteProof.lean, very_good->good in ShiftAndGlue.lean) already exists and just needs connection to the chronicle level.
